name: Matrimony.com Ltd
title: Matrimony.com Ltd - 540704 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Matrimony.com Q4 FY26 consolidated billing rose 9.9% YoY to INR 126.1 crore; management guides Q1 FY27 PAT to more than double.
summary.overview: Matchmaking billing grew 10.5% YoY to INR 125.4 crore in Q4 FY26, ahead of revenue growth of 8.4%, and Matchmaking EBITDA margin improved to 22% from 17.7% a year ago. Consolidated PAT rose 18.9% YoY to INR 9.7 crore, but full-year PAT fell to INR 34.2 crore from INR 45.3 crore as FY26 revenue grew only 0.9% and the Marriage Service and other segment loss persisted. Management said the one-year "Till You Marry" package is now flowing into revenue, narrowing the gap between billing and revenue. Management expects Q1 FY27 PAT to more than double year on year and billing growth in double digits or high single digits.

segments.name: Matchmaking
segments.commentary: Q4 billing INR 125.4 crore (+10.5% YoY), revenue INR 116 crore (+8.4% YoY); paid profiles 2.34 lakh (-4.3% YoY, +3.3% QoQ); average transaction value +15.3% YoY. FY26 billing INR 485.2 crore (+8.3%), revenue INR 455.7 crore (+1.3%).

segments.name: Marriage Service and other
segments.commentary: Q4 billing INR 73 lakh (-40.7% YoY), revenue INR 85 lakh (-36% YoY); EBITDA loss INR 5.7 crore vs INR 4.9 crore in Q4 FY25 and INR 3.2 crore in Q3, including impairment and ManyJobs costs. FY26 billing INR 3.4 crore (-25.9%), revenue INR 4.29 crore (-27%), EBITDA loss INR 15 crore vs INR 14.5 crore.

guidance_outlook: Q1 FY27: management is highly confident of either double-digit or high single-digit billing growth, double-digit revenue growth, and more than doubling of PAT versus Q1 FY26.
Marketing expenses expected to stay at a similar level (FY26 Matchmaking marketing INR 180 crore vs INR 185 crore in FY25) unless needs change.
Billing growth expected to converge with revenue growth as the one-year package revenue recognition flows through from Q4 FY26 onward.
Matchmaking double-digit or high single-digit billing growth expected in FY27.
Marriage Service and other losses expected to stay at a similar level; breakeven not expected in the near term, with a review possible in a couple of quarters or by year end.
capex_capacity: First Elite Matrimony Center opened in Hyderabad in Q4 FY26; management did not disclose segment-level numbers for Elite Matrimony.
Share buyback of INR 58.5 crore completed in Q4 FY26; management said further shareholder rewards would be evaluated subject to Board and shareholder approval.

ManyJobs monetisation started in Tamil Nadu only; over 1 million registered users and more than 10,000 companies using it. Expansion to South or pan India planned after reaching a revenue milestone, likely by year end.
Investment made in an early-stage AI-based astrology startup; Astro Free Chart is in experiment stage with monetisation still undecided.
demand_pricing: Average transaction value up 15.3% YoY and 3.6% QoQ in Q4; growth driven by Personalized Services and Online Services, with renewal rates and first-time conversion rates marginally higher.
Customer acquisition cost described as broadly stable YoY.
Organized matrimony market estimated at over INR 1,000 crore; dating about INR 100 crore plus. Management said organized online reach is around 15 million of 60 million people seeking partners.
Management said Tier-2 and Tier-3 combined is larger than Tier-1 market. Q4 and Q1 are the strongest quarters; Q2 and Q3 are festival-impacted.
Management said Luv.com (serious matchmaking, largely metro) is in early stages with good traction.

qa_highlights.question: Why did PAT fall about 24.5% and why did expenses rise while income was flat?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said total expenses rose 1.95% (about INR 9 crore impact), and finance income fell about INR 5 crore due to lower investment balance after buybacks and lower yields after repo rate cuts.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Bharat Ek Khoj 'Till You Marry' pack contribution to revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Pack launched March 2025 as a one-year package; billing started translating to revenue from Q4 FY26. FY26 billing exceeded revenue by about INR 28 crore; billing and revenue growth expected to align in coming quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What is the plan for the Marriage Service losses, and will there be a demerger?
qa_highlights.answer: Wedding Services moved from subscription to service-based model; management expects better traction this year but breakeven is a long way off, with a review in a couple of quarters or by year end. No demerger was discussed.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 EBITDA margin outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give a margin number; it said profit would more than double from Q1 and margins would improve.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company prioritising premiumisation over paid subscriber volume?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said both are being pursued; Personalized Services are growing faster than Online, but volume momentum is expected to start this year.

qa_highlights.question: How much of organized matchmaking is online and what is the penetration?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to size unorganized market; said Matrimony.com alone has 8-10 million sign-ups and about 1 million paid subscribers, and around 15 million of 60 million seeking partners use online platforms.

risks_watch: Paid profiles fell 4.3% YoY to 2.34 lakh; subscriber volume recovery is needed for sustained growth.
Marriage Service and other segment EBITDA loss widened to INR 5.7 crore in Q4 and is expected to stay at a similar level; no breakeven timeline.
Q1 FY27 guidance (PAT more than doubling) depends on billing-to-revenue conversion and stable marketing spend; FY26 revenue growth was only 0.9%.
Finance income is falling due to lower cash deployed in buybacks and lower interest rates.
Investor-relations question on promoter share pledge and insider trade disclosure was not fully answered on the call; management said it would check.
summary.management_tone: Confident on Matchmaking growth and the Q1 FY27 profit turnaround, but noticeably vague on the Marriage Service losses and on any margin target. Management declined to share Elite Matrimony or Astrology numbers and deflected some questions on promoter pledge as personal.
key_quotes: We are highly confident in delivering robust financial performance, anticipating either double-digit billing growth or high single-digit growth in billing, double-digit revenue growth and more than doubling of profit compared to Q1 of last year.
In terms of share pledge, it's a personal thing.
we definitely see the bigger opportunity in the Wedding Services or Other initiatives.
